summary_en: Supplementary materials for euro yen convertible bond issuance and share buyback program. Size, yen amount, price ceiling, execution window, and method not disclosed in excerpt provided.
title_en: Supplementary materials regarding euro yen convertible bond issuance and share buyback
translation_en_brief: Marui Group filed supplementary materials on August 24, 2026, regarding a euro yen convertible bond issuance and a concurrent share buyback program. The excerpt provided does not contain the key terms of the buyback (share count, yen budget, price ceiling, execution window, or method). The context references the company's management vision and strategy document "2031" released in May 2025, which emphasizes evolution toward a business supporting customer interests through a combination of retail, fintech, and co-creation investment. The buyback appears to be part of a capital structure package coordinated with the convertible bond offering. Full program details would appear in subsequent sections of the disclosure not shown in the excerpt.
